g.text: <<use>> IStore: atomic state, timer and outbox changes

circle.style: stroke: rgb(14%,36%,51%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;

path.style: stroke: rgb(14%,36%,51%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: none; fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Solid: assembly / API call Dashed arrow: usage dependency
1 Alert -> coordinator -> rotation lookup -> durable notification request; worker sends through external providers over HTTPS.
2 Acknowledgement updates incident state and cancels escalation atomically. Each timer rechecks state before advancing a tier.
3 Workers claim durable jobs through IStore; notifications retry with idempotency keys. Console writes pass through the coordinator.
Logical components, not separate microservices. App replicas and worker processes share the business code and repository.
